rules.when: a worker runs on this runtime
rules.why: agy renders no trust dialog for a launch, so the gate is never consulted for it. A plain Enter submits. Its composer is a bare prompt glyph, so the rendered busy footer is what acknowledges the submit. A single Escape cancels the turn, printing its interrupted row with an idle composer and nothing restored. A relaunch cannot resume an exact session, so it starts fresh. agy runs operator and Recon work only. While a turn runs the pane pins an `esc to cancel` status row with a model cell; idle it shows `? for shortcuts` instead. Its live reading is owned by bin/jg-busy-lib.sh.
